title: King Senarat
biography: Senarat (1604–1635) ruled Kandy for 31 years, navigating Portuguese military pressure and internal succession disputes. His lengthy reign maintained highland independence through strategic defensive warfare and diplomatic maneuvering. He reinforced Buddhist institutions and irrigation networks, sustaining Kandy's role as the protector of Sinhalese culture.

sections.heading: Biography
content: Senarat (1604–1635) ruled Kandy for 31 years, navigating Portuguese military pressure and internal succession disputes. His lengthy reign maintained highland independence through strategic defensive warfare and diplomatic maneuvering. He reinforced Buddhist institutions and irrigation networks, sustaining Kandy's role as the protector of Sinhalese culture.

internationalConnections: He resisted Portuguese encirclement, cultivated alliances with Jaffna and regional powers, and enshrined the Tooth Relic. His policies laid the groundwork for Kandy's survival through centuries of colonial warfare..
